misconfig_patterns: Unconfigured instance (no admin created) leaves /setup walkable and the single-use setup-token live and unauth-readable -> pre-auth RCE surface (CVE-2023-38646)
Instance pinned below 0.46.6.1 / 1.46.6.1 keeps the setup-token leak + JDBC-injection RCE chain exploitable even after admin creation, depending on patch line
Bundled H2 sample database present (has-sample-database:true) supplies the public exploit its preferred JDBC target (zip:/app/metabase.jar!/sample-database.db)
Direct exposure of port 3000 with no fronting proxy puts the full unauth /api/session/properties settings blob (version, setup-token, engines, branding, SSO config) on the public internet
Enterprise embedding (enable-embedding) with a weak/leaked embedding secret or mishandled JWT SSO token exposes signed-embed bypass

response_markers: JSON keys setup-token + has-sample-database + version.tag together (vendor-unique triad)
version.tag holds the authoritative version string (e.g. v0.48.1)
engines map lists every available DB driver (postgres/mysql/bigquery/snowflake/h2/...)
setup-token non-null = unconfigured instance, pre-auth RCE leak vector live; null = admin configured
active_probe.false_positive_check: Bare 'Metabase' in http.title/html collides with product mirrors, doc sites, marketing/embed proxies, and Metabase Cloud SaaS login pages (*.metabaseapp.com, patched + out of scope for self-hosted surveys). To cut the moderate-to-high FP: confirm the unauth JSON contract at GET /api/session/properties -> must return a JSON object carrying setup-token, has-sample-database, AND version.tag. A doc/blog mirror or reverse-proxied marketing page 404s this route. The metabase.SESSION Set-Cookie header is the near-zero-FP secondary tell. Distinguish unconfigured (setup-token non-null = pre-auth RCE candidate) from configured (setup-token null, login wall at /auth/login). pgvector/AI-backend is NOT visible at the engine layer (rides inside a normal postgres engine); AI-wired confirmation is an auth-gated schema/name read (/api/database, card/question names with embedding/vector/llm/rag), which is the verify lane's job.

On non-null setup-token + unpatched version: CVE-2023-38646 chain (POST /api/setup/validate, details.db JDBC H2 TRACE_LEVEL trigger RCE) -- VERIFY-LANE / controlled-target only, never run against a survey set
Auth-gated /api/database -> enumerate configured databases, engines, dbname/host to scope the data backend (postgres present = pgvector possible)
Read card/question/collection names for AI-shaped tells (embedding/vector/pgvector/cosine/similarity/llm/rag/chunks/inference) = in-scope AI-wired BI confirmation
Read site-name / application-name / application-logo-url from properties for operator branding/attribution (custom logo = named tenant)

vulnerabilities: CVE-2023-38646 -- pre-auth RCE (Critical, CVSS 9.8). Unauth setup-token leak via /api/session/properties (and login HTML) -> POST /api/setup/validate with details.db JDBC string -> H2 TRACE_LEVEL_SYSTEM_OUT + stacked SQL + CREATE TRIGGER AS $$//javascript$$ = command exec at server privilege. Affected OSS <0.43.7.2, 0.44.0-0.44.7.1, 0.45.0-0.45.4.1, 0.46.0-0.46.6.1; Ent equivalents on 1.x. Fixed 0.46.6.1/1.46.6.1 (+back-ports 0.45.4.1/0.44.7.1/0.43.7.2 and 1.x equivalents)
CVE-2023-39752 -- pre-auth info disclosure / null-pointer DoS on the setup surface (companion to 38646)
CVE-2021-41277 -- local file inclusion / SSRF via custom GeoJSON map-URL (/api/geojson), pre-auth; fixed 0.40.5 / 1.40.5

JWT-class (Enterprise embedding/SSO only): leaked MB_EMBEDDING_SECRET_KEY / MB_JWT_SHARED_SECRET enables signed-embed bypass; unsigned/alg-mishandled embedding tokens. Not a default-instance issue (requires enable-embedding)
auth_evidence: PRIMARY SOURCE: Metabase ships an unconfigured setup flow on first boot, gated by a single-use setup-token minted at boot. GET /api/session/properties returns an UNAUTHENTICATED JSON settings blob whose 'setup-token' field holds that UUID while the instance is unconfigured (null once an admin exists). NVD CVE-2023-38646 and Assetnote primary research confirm the token leaks via this endpoint (and the index/login HTML embedding the same JSON), and that POST /api/setup/validate with a details.db JDBC string drives the H2 injection to RCE. NVD affected ranges: OSS <0.43.7.2 / 0.44.0-0.44.7.1 / 0.45.0-0.45.4.1 / 0.46.0-0.46.6.1; Enterprise 1.x equivalents. Fixed 0.46.6.1 / 1.46.6.1, CVSS 9.8. The vulnerability is not weak passwords; it is an unauth-readable setup token plus a database-add path that reaches code execution => setup-flow-token-gated, pre-auth-RCE on unconfigured/unpatched.
sensitive_assets: version.tag / version.hash / setup-token / has-sample-database / engines list -- all unauth via /api/session/properties (fingerprint + version + RCE-candidacy in one read)
Configured database connection details (engine, host, dbname) via /api/database when session is obtained
Dashboard/question SQL and result data over the connected backends (the BI data layer -- potentially pgvector/embedding/LLM-analytics tables in scope for Cat-16 AI-wired BI)
Operator attribution: site-name, application-name, application-logo-url, google-auth-client-id, SSO config from properties
Embedding secret / JWT shared secret on Enterprise instances with embedding enabled
On RCE: full server-privilege command execution and the Metabase app DB (encrypted connection secrets for every connected warehouse)
